{"id":"07145fa0a665557ffb825b0a7c0ae635","type":"message","role":"assistant","model":"MiniMax-M3","content":[{"text":"Looking at the original problem:

**Probability that the first roll is greater than 3:**
Values greater than 3: {4, 5, 6} = 3 outcomes out of 6
P(first roll > 3) = 3/6 = 1/2 = 50%

**Probability that the first two rolls are both even:**
Even values: {2, 4, 6} = 3 outcomes out of 6 per roll
P(both even) = (3/6) × (3/6) = 1/4 = 25%

**Difference:**
50% - 25% = **25 percentage points**

The first probability is **25 percentage points** larger than the second probability.","type":"text"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":784,"output_tokens":154,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":128,"service_tier":"standard"},"stop_reason":"end_turn","base_resp":{"status_code":0,"status_msg":""}}
